title: Micelclaw OS Ep. 4 — Contacts: the people behind the show
description:
Every show ends the same way: a list of people to thank, restock from, and book again. Ep. 4 of the Module Tours is Contacts — everyone behind BoomClaw Pyrotechnics, on your own hardware.

Ask "who wires our shows?" and the agent answers with the person, as a clickable chip. Say a new phone number, and the card updates itself. Search "chrysanthemum" and find the artist by what you remember about her — not her name.
